advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Prevent _materialize_stale_running from clobbering a terminal verdict the daemon wrote after gate_status's initial read (race between record_gate_run and complete()).
evidence: Shared resource: durable index file '.rebar/gate_runs/<job_id>', written last-writer-wins via atomic_write (record_gate_run, src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py:84).
Executor 2 (daemon thread) spawn: src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:196 `spawn_context_daemon(_bg, name=f"rebar-gate-{gate_type}")`.

Daemon ordering: src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:191 `rebar.llm.record_gate_run(record)` (terminal write) runs BEFORE :192 `handle.complete(...)` which via _finish sets `entry.done = True` (src/rebar/_mcp_inflight.py:225).
is_job_active checks `not e.done` (src/rebar/_mcp_inflight.py:177), so it returns False only after the terminal record is already persisted.

Interleaving READ: `rec = read_gate_run(job_id, repo_root=repo_root)` at src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py:288 (rec.status still 'running'); then `_resolve_status` calls `is_job_active(job_id)` at :248 which now returns False and grace has elapsed -> returns 'stale-running'.

Interleaving WRITE: `_materialize_stale_running(rec, ...)` at src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py:298 builds `settled = dict(rec)` from the stale rec (:259) and calls `record_gate_run(settled, ...)` (:268), overwriting the daemon's terminal record.

Harm: lost update — a real 'passed'/'failed' verdict recorded by the daemon is replaced by a spurious status='failed', verdict='daemon-stopped', error='async gate daemon stopped before recording a terminal result'; the poller and any persisted consumer read the wrong outcome.
Guard-detects-but-proceeds: no re-read or status/version check is performed between the :288 read and the :268 write; the materialize does not re-fetch the record to confirm it is still 'running'.
advisory.finding: _materialize_stale_running overwrites the durable gate_runs index with a 'failed'/'daemon-stopped' record built from a stale in-memory copy, clobbering a terminal verdict the daemon may have just written. Because the daemon's finally calls record_gate_run(terminal) BEFORE handle.complete() marks its registry entry done, the is_job_active()==False guard that gates stale-running becomes true only AFTER the terminal record is on disk — so materialize proceeds precisely into the window where a real 'passed'/'failed' verdict exists, and last-writer-wins overwrites it.
scenarios: A 15-20 min gate daemon (well past the 5s grace) finishes and writes 'passed' at the exact moment a client polls gate_status; the poll clobbers it with a 'failed' daemon-stopped record.
Concurrent poll racing the daemon's finally between record_gate_run and complete().
advisory.suggested_fix: Re-read the record immediately before overwriting and only materialize if it still reads 'running' (e.g. re-check inside _materialize_stale_running via read_gate_run and bail to the freshly-read terminal record), or reorder the daemon finally so complete() precedes record_gate_run and add a version/status compare-and-set on the index write.
